item.title: ICE Leaves Minneapolis To Focus On American Cities
item.description: U.S. — Border Czar Tom Homan announced on Friday that ICE would be withdrawing from Minneapolis in a strategic move to instead focus on enforcing laws in American cities.

item.title: Husband Enters Annual Hibernation Period Between Super Bowl And MLB Opening Day
item.description: BLUE SPRINGS, MO — One of nature's most wondrous events was on full display at one suburban home this week, as a local husband followed his innate instinct to enter his annual hibernation period between the Super Bowl and Major League Baseball Opening Day.

item.title: Jacob's 'I Love You Almost As Much As I Love Your Sister' Valentine Card Not A Big Hit With Leah
item.description: SUCCOTH — Local patriarch Jacob was reportedly confused this week when his wife, Leah, appeared unimpressed with the Valentine's Day card he gave her that read, "I love you almost as much as I love your sister."

item.title: The Babylon Bee Ranks Humanity's Worst Inventions
item.description: Since the invention of the wheel, many have pondered the greatest inventions of mankind. The Babylon Bee, however, is more fascinated by studying humanity's worst inventions.

item.title: Trump Approves Use Of Poké Balls To Catch Illegal Immigrants
item.description: WASHINGTON, D.C. — President Donald Trump issued an executive order on Friday authorizing the use of Poké Balls to catch illegal immigrants.

item.title: Gruesome Kidnapping Just The Career Boost Crime Reporter Has Been Waiting For
item.description: U.S. — Up-and-coming crime reporter Megan Coolidge said she was excited to hear about the latest gruesome kidnapping case, as it would be a huge boost to her career.

item.title: Finally! Groundbreaking Documentary Takes A Look At World War 2
item.description: U.S. — Finally, after decades of obscurity on the subject, a groundbreaking new documentary will reportedly examine the history of World War II.
